edits.old: the legacy criteria name no window and this story sets none.
edits.new: the legacy criteria name no window and this story sets none. No deviation, screening or queue volume is stated for this module: the only quantities are the evaluation samples of 200 and 500 cases, and no source states the deviations open at go-live, the screening runs a night, the deviation queue size or the rule evaluations per screen. The platform figures are 23,600 open cases at go-live and 3,110 new a month (NFR-001), about 370 staff online of 914 (NFR-002) and 300 milliseconds per rule evaluation (NFR-011); the 05:00 to 07:00 morning run includes rwb-deviation (Architecture v5 slide 33). No volume target is set here; the real deviation rate is measured in the shadow run before the wave 2 volume test is sized.

    Given the rwb-case contract mock returns case "RW-2027-000801" with product group MORTGAGE, region BKK and status "In progress"
    When the agent runs
